# Event pages of real frames, for EventPageTests (the text-ink page-change check).
# <file> <ko|en> <event|ancient> <visit>:<page>
# A visit is one stay in one event room; frames of a visit with the same page show the same option text (hover,
# glow and fades aside), frames with another page show other text. ko frames: the developer's test captures
# (data/local/test-captures); en frames: STS2_EN_FRAMES_DIR. Page names are this file's own (I = first page,
# END = the last, a/b/P2 = later pages). en01:ALL holds frames of one page whose option numbers differ
# (a counter on the button): the same page by design.
